evidence.quote: See the real cost of every FX transaction. Run a free audit in under 60 seconds.
Every request requires a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Keys start with `ipx_live_`.
Method: HTTP Bearer token in `Authorization` header. Format: `ipx_live_xxxxx` (production) or `ipx_test_xxxxx` (sandbox).

result.notes: iPayX is an FX-audit forensic tool (compares bank/card FX rates to mid-market). Docs describe a small REST API (3 endpoints: /audit, /rates, /audit/document) using Bearer-token auth (key prefixes ipx_live_/ipx_test_), plus a vendor-hosted MCP server (same bearer-token auth) documented at /docs/mcp-server for Claude/Perplexity/n8n. The public pricing/developers page lists only paid tiers, cheapest 'Developer' plan at $99/mo (100 audits/mo, includes sandbox) — no clearly self-serve free API tier was confirmed, though a 'Test Sandbox' UI page (/mcp-test) exists that may allow limited unauthenticated demo calls (unconfirmed, page didn't clearly state whether it requires login). No OAuth2/JWT/API-key-header scheme found — auth is HTTP Bearer only. Composio catalog and MCP registry only show community/unofficial repos, but the vendor's own docs describe and host an official MCP server, so mcp.status is set to official rather than community.
result.one_liner: iPayX is a forensic FX-audit platform/API that scores international payment transactions against live mid-market rates to surface hidden bank/card markups.
